title: Campaign progression design and roadmap
excerpt: Public issue metadata for planning campaign progression as a parent design and roadmap task.
lesson: Split a large progression feature into a design task and dependent implementation tasks.

title: Campaign persistent state store and Lua API
excerpt: Public issue metadata for a persistent state store and scripting API used by campaign progression.
lesson: Persistent state and its API precede mission selection and post-victory flow.

title: Campaign progress schema and Lua boilerplate
excerpt: Public issue metadata for a standard progress schema and shared scripting boilerplate.
lesson: Define a shared schema before multiple missions write progression data.

title: Campaign mission browser integration
excerpt: Public issue metadata for integrating campaign progress with the mission browser.
lesson: UI integration follows persistence schema and runtime API work.

title: Renderer batch flush dropped sprites
excerpt: A closed public issue reports sprites being silently dropped when a sampler-limit flush occurred mid-batch.
lesson: Renderer batching changes need boundary-condition regression tests.

title: Crash when removing station tiles
excerpt: Closed public issue metadata for a crash triggered by removing station tiles.
lesson: Destructive world-edit actions require state-integrity and crash regression tests.

title: Autofill adds timetable times incorrectly
excerpt: Closed public issue metadata for incorrect timetable values produced by autofill.
lesson: Simulation automation requires deterministic calculation tests and visible correction paths.

title: Text layout crash
excerpt: Closed public issue metadata for a segmentation fault in paragraph layout.
lesson: UI text and localization need malformed-input and platform-library regression coverage.

title: Airport dimensions returned incorrectly
excerpt: Closed public issue metadata for API methods returning incorrect airport width and height.
lesson: Public gameplay APIs need contract tests for spatial dimensions and edge cases.

title: Cargo destination missing with dummy orders
excerpt: Open public issue metadata for cargo never receiving a destination when dummy orders are present.
lesson: Routing systems need scenarios covering placeholder and incomplete orders.

title: Windows installer missing required runtime
excerpt: Open public issue metadata for a Windows installer that does not offer a required C++ runtime.
lesson: Release validation includes clean-machine dependency and installer testing.

title: OpenGL ES 3 support
excerpt: Open public task metadata for OpenGL ES 3.x support on mobile platforms.
lesson: Mobile renderer support needs capability detection, shader compatibility and device testing tasks.

title: Moving surface physics interactions
excerpt: Open public enhancement metadata for interactions between moving surfaces and objects.
lesson: Moving-platform features span collision response, relative velocity and gameplay tests.

title: Menu frame-rate limit behavior
excerpt: Open public enhancement metadata for avoiding very low gameplay frame limits on menu screens.
lesson: Performance settings need separate gameplay and menu acceptance tests.

title: Replay camera look-back failure
excerpt: Open public defect metadata for look-back controls failing while a replay is paused.
lesson: Replay controls need state-transition tests for play, pause and camera modes.
